For a limited time, you can bring home your own Light Orc!

notes.title: Windows Update 24H2 Fix
notes.content:
Orcs Must Die! is still a beloved favorite so we appreciate our community's patience while we got to the bottom of this issue.

We have corrected an issue with the underlying game engine that was introduced with Windows Update 24H2.  Players should now be able to utilize all supported game resolutions.   

Our thanks to our friends at Firefly Studios for determining the root cause of the issue in the Vision engine and suggesting a solution.

[i][b]Note that if a player has followed our previous suggestion and created a user.cfg file specifying that the game start in "window" mode, the player will have to manually remove or rename that file for any new video settings to persist across gaming sessions.[/b][/i]

notes.title: Orcs Must Die! 3 is now available!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=sDj_Ksx2-tk;full][/previewyoutube]

Orcs Must Die! 3 has arrived! You can pick it up and play on Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4, Playstation 5 via backwards compatability, Steam, and with streaming via GeForce NOW.

Orcs Must Die! 3 brings in a new campaign and story, focusing on the Order 20 years after Orcs Must Die! 2. Remember, it's all about one thing: Orcs. Must. Die.

notes.title: Scramble Mode is coming to Orcs Must Die! 3!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ke9E6Su.jpg[/img]

One of the latest and greatest additions to the upcoming Orcs Must Die! 3 release is Scramble Mode, a new game mode where you battle orcs across 5 random levels as both sides escalate in power. In Scramble Mode, you have just one enhanced pool of rift points across all 5 levels, so you will need to carefully choose your buffs, debuffs, and loadouts in order to survive!!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9Vyo7Ak.jpg[/img]

When you first enter Scramble Mode, you will be prompted to make a choice between two different levels, each of which will come with a unique debuff, something to make the Orc army more terrifying. For instance, you might have options like “Lose 10 rift points on death”, “Increase mana cost of all weapons”, “Adds dynamite archers to every wave. Makes dynamite archers stronger”, or some of the dozens of other debuffs available.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YRiZhvl.jpg[/img]

The good news is, if you manage to survive the first level with some rift points intact, you will get a choice between three buffs, something to improve your own odds. These are options like “All wall traps do double damage”, “Double your hit points”, “Headshots heal the player”, or one of more than 50 total buffs. After you choose your buff, you once again pick from two more level options, each with their corresponding debuffs. You have the chance to reroll one debuff per tier, but be careful, as you might get stuck with something even tricker to deal with!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WftgXc6.jpg[/img]

This means that by the 5th tier, you will have some combination of 4 buffs, and the orcs will have some combination of 5 debuffs against you - leading to a whole lot of possible combinations each time you run through Scramble Mode. We hope everyone enjoys the new game mode on July 23rd, when Orcs Must Die! 3 launches!

notes.title: Orcs Must Die! 3 marks the return of a quintessential co-op series to Steam
notes.content: What does the perfect Steam co-op experience look like? It’d be nice if it was a good game, of course, but that’s a secondary factor. Above all, it’s got to be convenient: downloadable in the space between a lunchtime WhatsApp exchange and an 8pm start time. It should require coordination, but not so much that you can’t have a chat about Loki. And ideally, it should already be sitting there in your Steam library—having presumably gone cheap in a previous sale, though you have no memory of buying it... Read more.

notes.title: Orcs Must Die! 3 is coming to Steam on July 23rd!
notes.content:
[h2]Orcs Must Die! 3 is coming to Steam, Playstation, and Xbox![/h2]

[previewyoutube=SpI7weW7SjE;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Orcs Must Die! 3[/i] is getting ready to break through to Steam! On July 23, you’ll be able to play [i]Orcs Must Die! 3[/i] solo or cooperatively to experience the same great Orc slaying fun from the previous games, along with all new content to make burning, flipping, and skewering Orcs even more exciting! Orcs Must Die! 3 see the return of many classic favorites like Spike Traps, Arrow Walls, and the sweet sound of Max’s voice, before improving it with all new traps, weapons, story, and game modes! 

[i]Orcs Must Die! 3[/i] is cranking up the scale with all new War Scenarios where hundreds of Orcs rush at your gates all at once! To help combat these massive waves, new traps exclusive to War Scenarios like the Mega Boom Barrel Launcher and the Giant Flip Trap can be placed outside the castle to help tear through the horde! You’ll also be able to take on returning Weekly Challenge and Endless game modes, along with a new Scramble mode where Warmages and the Orcs get buffs to make every try different! The Order has even come up with some new traps to make the life of a Warmage even more exciting, such as the Acid Geyser and the Sawblade Launcher!

For more details about pre-order bonuses, new content, or information about the release, check out the Orcs Must Die! 3 store page or follow us on social media!

[h2]Play Orcs Must Die! 2 for free this week![/h2]

To celebrate the launch of [i]Orcs Must Die! 3[/i], [i]Orcs Must Die! 2[/i] will be free to play on Steam from June 13th until June 20th! This is a great time to try out the [i]Orcs Must Die![/i] franchise and see what all the Orc smashing, flambéing, and pummeling is about!

Everything [i]Orcs Must Die![/i] is also 80% off! Now is a great time to pick up [i]Orcs Must Die![/i], [i]Orcs Must Die! 2[/i], or any DLC you may still need to pick up!

notes.title: Cute pulp sci-fi defensive shooter Fortified is free today
notes.content:
How about a little something to unwind for the evening with? A charming looking free game tickle your fancy? Fortified has apparently been around on Steam early 2016, but it managed to fly entirely under my radar. A crying shame, because it looks like Orcs Must Die spliced with Mars Attacks. Developer Clapfoot (working on the currently-in-early-access Foxhole) have opted to just give it away for free today. If you nab it on Steam between now and 11am Pacific Time on June 8th, you get to keep it forever.

notes.title: Orcs Must Die! Unchained is now available!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/427270/extras/orcs-running-header.jpg[/img]


Robot Entertainment today announced that their hilarious action tower defense game [b][u]ORCS MUST DIE! UNCHAINED[/u][/b] is now commercially available! Players can download the game from Steam or directly from OrcsMustDie.com.

[u]Orcs Must Die! Unchained [/u] takes the award-winning [u]Orcs Must Die![/u] action tower defense gameplay to a whole new level with 3-player team-based gameplay! But don’t get cocky, because the stakes are higher, the traps are bloodier, and the invaders are even more ravenous. You’ll need to bring your A-game and a couple of the biggest orc-haters you can find!

[u]Orcs Must Die! Unchained[/u] is set in the familiar world of its hilarious fantasy predecessors, years after the finale of [u]Orcs Must Die! 2[/u]. With dozens of new rifts and worlds beyond them, heroes have come from far and wide to wage all-out war for control of these magical gateways. In the years since [u]Orcs Must Die! 2[/u], Maximillian and Gabriella have done their best to rebuild the once-mighty Order.

[b]Features[/b]
[list][*][b]Killin’ Orcs and Smashin’ Dorks – [/b][u]Orcs Must Die! [/u]’s classic white-knuckle witch’s brew of action and strategy returns, letting players team up with their friends to lay waste to millions of new invading monsters!  Build an impenetrable gauntlet of traps to hack, grind, flatten, gibletize and incinerate foes before they charge into the heart of the rift!
 [/*][*][b]It's Definitely a Trap [/b] [b]– [/b]The only thing better than building traps for murdering minions is building more traps! Play to unlock traps, then upgrade them to be even deadlier. Players cover fortresses in gleeful torture devices and engineer a variety of hilarious and violent ends for invading minions. Customize a strategy for every battle. The hordes are no match for the powers of elements and physics![/*][*][b]Real Action Heroes [/b] [b]– [/b]Are you mage enough to defend the rifts? A wide variety of unique and powerful heroes with deep gameplay options offer a plethora of painfully creative ways to stop orcs in their grimy tracks[b].[/b] Old friends Max and Gabriella return to fight alongside a cast of new heroes like Blackpaw, Hogarth, Stinkeye, and Bloodspike. Whether players prefer might and majesty or scum and villainy, there’s a hero for every type of orc-slayer around.[/*][*][b]Your Favorite Ways to Slay [/b] [b]– [/b]Survival mode lets players murder their way to the top of the orc pile in 3-player co-op defense gameplay that every [u]Orcs Must Die![/u] fan will love. Weekly Challenges and Daily Quests give players the chance to unlock extra traps and upgrade parts. Long-time favorite Endless mode has returned in [u]Orcs Must Die! Unchained[/u] with expanded 3-player co-op. All new Sabotage mode sets up two teams of three to troll each other with spells and bosses in an action-packed race to the highest score.[/*][*][b]All New Sabotage![/b] – Gamers ready for a trap-snapping, spell-slinging, ogre-spudging good time can look no further than Orcs Must Die! Unchained's new game mode, Sabotage! This fast-paced mode is a totally new way to play. Players assemble a team to defend their rift, but at the same time another team is playing on the same map in some… spooky… alternate dimension or something. These other players can distract your team with spells, minions, and huge bosses to make you lose rift points. But of course, players can pay 'em back by doing the same! The team with the most rift points at the end of the match wins.[/*][/list]
Orcs Must Die! Unchained will also be available on PlayStation 4 later this year. 
 

Click below to read the detailed patch notes and give us your feedback!
[url=https://forums.orcsmustdie.com/discussion/12560/release-2-0-sabotage-commercial-release-notes]Patch Notes & Feedback[/url]

notes.title: Orc Week Celebration for OMDU Launch Announcement!
notes.content:
[h1]OMDU to release on April 19, 2017! [/h1]
That’s right, War Mages, Orcs Must Die! Unchained is exiting open beta and officially launching on April 19! This free-to-play commercial release features classic Orcs Must Die! gameplay players and also heralds the return of head-to-head gameplay in the form of Sabotage, a brand new 3v3 party game mode.

[h1]Introducing Sabotage![/h1]
Gamers ready for a trap-snapping, spell-slinging, ogre-spudging good time can look no further than Orcs Must Die! Unchained's new game mode, Sabotage! This fast-paced mode is a totally new way to play. Players assemble a team to defend their rift, but at the same time another team is playing on the same map in some… spooky… alternate dimension or something. These other players can distract your team with spells, minions, and huge bosses to make you lose rift points. But of course, players can pay 'em back by doing the same! The team with the most rift points at the end of the match wins.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LBA1uNsJsBg
[h1]Join Us For a Special Orcs After Dark Sabotage Preview![/h1]
We have a very special Orcs After Dark show planned TONIGHT in celebration of this announcement! Join us at 6:30 Central as Robot developers preview Sabotage mode for the OMDU community. 

Head over to the [url=http://forums.orcsmustdie.com/]official forums[/url] now to join the discussion with your fellow War Mages, and be sure to tune into OrcsMustDie.tv on Thursday night to get an exclusive first look at Sabotage mode.

[h1]Celebrate Orc Week with OMD Franchise Discounts[/h1]
To celebrate the news, Robot Entertainment has kicked off Orc Week. Gamers can relish in the destruction of green meanies with 90% off all Orcs Must Die! games and DLC on Steam from April 4th to April 10th. 

The Orcs Must Die! Franchise Pack has been updated for Orc Week to include Orcs Must Die! Unchained and a brand new Starter Bundle containing skulls, gold, and a week of Survival Pass time!

Visit OrcWeek.com for all of the Steam sale details and a wide array of orcish celebrations!

notes.title: Orcs Must Die! Unchained refocuses on classic PvE
notes.content: Orcs Must Die! Unchained [official site] has launched a huge update taking the tower defense closer to its roots. The unpopular PvP mode is gone, for starters, which devs Robot Entertainment say is so they can “fully focus on bringing back the classic Orcs Must Die gameplay that players thought was missing in OMD!U”. Smashing! I enjoyed the earlier games, with their mix of building wacky traps and roaming around on foot fighting monsters myself, but didn’t dig what Unchained was up to. … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Orcs Must Die! Updated
notes.content:
Updates to Orcs Must Die! have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted. The major changes include:

• Added a user.cfg option to limit your frame rate “forceFPS=X” where X is what you do not want it to run faster than (for example: forceFPS=30).
• Added custom keybinding using user.cfg
• Fix for the Tenderized achievement.
• Fix for the fireball achievement.
• Switch to a hardware cursor to help people with slower machines.
• Fixed up the cursor acceleration option slider to make it more useable.
• Fixed up pathing near the doors on Twin Halls.
• Fixed the bug where you could have both costumes on at the same time.
• Fixed an issue where some levels, like Gateway, would crash the game.
• Fixed the text for the costume weapons if you had a particular weaver set selected
• Fixed "Oiled Gears" Weaver Upgrade
• Fixed a bug in upgraded Swinging Mace. It wasn't doing what it was supposed to. It is now.
